name: Sakuga
description: Prism cinema: a working anime catalog with vertical optical glass, electric blue and orange light

material.background: Locally authored cylindrical ribs and optional idle-loaded native WebGL light refraction
material.navigation: Suspended glass with modest backdrop blur
material.cards: Real artwork with reflected gradient edges

motion.cursor: Local transforms; no inherited root-variable updates per frame
motion.scroll: Native document and horizontal film strip; no scroll hijacking

artwork.delivery: Content-hashed immutable URLs, responsive sources, no source enlargement
artwork.scope: Selected homepage candidates; no claim of universal HD source coverage

homepage.feature: Up to six randomly selected distinct non-mature catalog shows; 7.5 second rotation; pause on focus, hover, hidden tab and manual control
homepage.popular: Horizontal film strip with swipe and bounded previous/next controls

preferences.sound: Opt-in click effects only; no lo-fi

review.scope: Local protocol fixture verifies UI, accessibility, session routing and season state; separate remote checks verify release delivery
review.performance: Three identical local headless pointer-motion samples: median task time 1.396s before / 0.679s after; median style recalculation 0.671s / 0.090s. Software-renderer static fallback; not production field Web Vitals.
